description: The INVESTOR view of a project, not the chart. With `symbol` (1–10 coins, e.g. 'AAVE,ARB'): (1) business — TVL (money deposited, 1d/7d change), fees users pay, revenue the project keeps (24h/7d/30d/1y + 30-day trend), market cap ÷ yearly revenue (lower = cheaper for what it earns); (2) funding — who invested (VC names, Tier 1 = top funds, lead), each round's date, price per token, amount and valuation, how supply is split (team / investors / public), and early_worth_now_x = today's price ÷ the cheapest round price (e.g. 40 = early investors are 40× in profit → possible selling pressure; < 1 = they are underwater). Without `symbol`: investment ideas — `list`: 'revenue' (earning the most), 'revenue_growth' (earnings growing fastest), 'cheapest' (lowest market cap vs revenue), 'tvl_growth' (money flowing in), 'recently_funded' (raised money in the last 180 days); leave out for all. Use for 'who invested in X', 'is X VC-backed', 'does X make money', 'is X undervalued', 'long-term investment ideas'. BTC and most memes have no revenue or private rounds. Business strength, not timing — pair with coin_brief and upcoming_unlocks.

list.description: Without symbol: one ideas list (default: all, top 10 each)

symbol.description: One or more coins, comma-separated (max 10), e.g. 'ARB' or 'AAVE,UNI,HYPE'
